assessment: The paper is well written and the experimental approach is sound. It contains a large amount of data and addresses an important and an understudied area of science. The authors were very responsive to the reviewers' comments and the reviewers unanimously decided that the paper is significantly improved and is ready for publication. The paper will likely have a high impact on the field, as it identifies changes in plasma lipids at the early stages after birth and its link with factors related to pregnancy.
